result.reason: The revision satisfies the fallback position: it creates a mutual aggregate cap, preserves the mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, includes the required fallback carve-outs for confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence and wilful misconduct, and clarifies that Customer payment obligations are not damages. It also adds the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor and fraud/IP carve-outs. It does not fully reach the preferred position because data protection and security breaches are not expressly carved out, and the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, although the one-sided section heading is inconsistent with the mutual operative language.
